name: cryptic-exon-q1: name the gene carrying the cryptic exon
description: CompBioBench cryptic-exon-q1, against a pinned dataset revision. Tier 3, live Galaxy. The input is staged into a clean history and nothing else is prescribed: no tools, no steps, no plan shape. The first turn is the benchmark prompt verbatim; the second is a fixed approval, because Olit holds a multi-step analysis at the plan gate and a single-turn benchmark would measure the gate rather than the science. Kept visible here rather than as harness behaviour. Graded the way the benchmark grades it, on the final HGNC symbol.
